courses.title: The Heart of Worship
courses.description: Why worship is about Jesus—not music, production, or performance. Curated teaching from Matt Redman on the story behind the song, plus reflection for our team.
learningObjectives: Understand why Soul Survivor Watford stripped music away to refocus worship
Examine your own motives when you serve on worship team
Return to offering God more than a song—worship from the heart

lessons.title: Team reflection: More than a song
lessons.bodyMarkdown:
## When the music fades

Matt Redman describes a season when leadership removed the band and sound system so the church could worship with **only voices and Bibles**. The awkward first week led him to ask: *When I serve, am I offering worship to God—or building my own thing?*

That question is for every worship team member, not just song leaders.

## Discuss or journal

1. What props do we lean on (sound, lights, familiar songs, strong voices) that can hide a dry heart?
2. When you are scheduled to serve, what is one way you prepare your **heart**, not only your part?
3. How can Shanah Worship keep Jesus at the center when we plan services and rehearsals?
